hook: Omar Sultan Al Olama became the world's first Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence when the United Arab Emirates created the post in October 2017. He was in his twenties at the time, having joined the Prime Minister's Office in 2012 after a year at Emirates NBD and a short spell as a spectrum research officer at the UAE telecoms regulator. The portfolio widened in July 2020 to cover the digital economy and remote work applications, and he has since added the directorships general of both the Prime Minister's Office and the Office of the Crown Prince of Dubai. He led the UAE Artificial Intelligence Strategy and the Dubai Metaverse Strategy.

standing.record: The site's records on Al Olama consist of his profile and a single news story, the meeting with the President of Ecuador in August 2026 to discuss ways to strengthen bilateral cooperation. No companies are listed under his name, and no lawsuits or court cases name him or any entity connected to him. What the record shows instead is an official who has moved through state institutions, including the Prime Minister's Office, which he joined in 2012, after a year at Emirates NBD and a spell at the UAE telecoms regulator. He was Managing Director of the World Government Summit from 2016 to 2023 and has sat on its executive committee since 2014, and he has been an advisory board member of the World Economic Forum Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution since January 2019. The pattern running through the material is governmental and advisory rather than commercial or litigious.
standing.standing: Omar Sultan Al Olama holds the post of UAE Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence, a position the United Arab Emirates created in October 2017 and the first of its kind in the world. His portfolio widened in July 2020 to take in the digital economy and remote work applications. He is Director General of the Office of His Highness the Crown Prince of Dubai, a role he has held since December 2023, and Director General of the UAE Prime Minister's Office since February 2023. He has chaired the Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy since March 2021 and serves as Deputy Managing Director and a Board of Trustees member of the Dubai Future Foundation. He led the UAE Artificial Intelligence Strategy and the Dubai Metaverse Strategy.

achievements.title: The first national AI ministry
achievements.impact: The UAE created the post in October 2017 and appointed him to it, making artificial intelligence a cabinet-level portfolio years before most governments had a national AI strategy at all.

achievements.title: The UAE Artificial Intelligence Strategy
achievements.impact: Led the national strategy that framed AI as economic infrastructure to be invested in rather than principally a risk to be regulated, a position the UAE has held consistently since.

achievements.title: Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy
achievements.impact: Chairman since 2021, the body charged with attracting and growing digital economy companies in Dubai.

achievements.title: World Government Summit
achievements.impact: Managing Director from 2016 to 2023 of the annual summit that has become a principal venue where governments discuss technology policy with each other.

achievements.title: Dubai Metaverse Strategy
achievements.impact: Led the strategy, an early state-level attempt to plan for an immersive computing economy.
